edges.reason: msg.sender-derived _msgSender() flows into _transfer as the sender.
setTaxAlloc compares _msgSender() against m_WebThree to authorise allocation changes.
setWebThree authorises the caller via _msgSender() against External.owner() and m_WebThree.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier checking _msgSender().
block.timestamp gates trading, launch window and cap logic inside _transfer.
addLiquidity uses block.timestamp as deadline and lock epoch.
launch derives the launch time from block.timestamp plus user timer.
_walletCapped compares block.timestamp against the launched window.
_checkTX compares block.timestamp to decide the transaction size limit.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline to the router.
tx.origin is used for blacklist checks and antibot scanning inside _transfer.
payTaxes performs a native ETH transfer to a recipient address, enabling reentrancy.
payTaxes calls External.deposit, an external contract interaction.
_swapTokensForETH invokes an external router swap that may reenter.
_disperseEth transfers ETH to the external reflection service address.
_transfer calls the external AntiBot service during exchange transfers.
_trackEthReflection calls the external EthReflect service to record sells.
addLiquidity calls the external LP lock service.
addLiquidity calls the external router addLiquidityETH.
transfer delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom calls _approve after transferring.
approve delegates to _approve.
_transfer calls _getTaxes to compute tax.
_transfer calls _tax to trigger swap and dispersion.
_transfer calls _updateBalances to apply movements.
_transfer calls _trackEthReflection.
_transfer calls _txRestricted to decide size restriction.
_transfer calls _walletCapped to decide the cap check.
_tax calls _swapTokensForETH.
_tax calls _disperseEth.
_tax calls _readyToTax.
_disperseEth calls _getTaxDenominator.
_disperseEth calls payTaxes.
updateDevWallet calls setTaxAlloc to reset and re-add the dev allocation.
updateTaxAlloc calls setTaxAlloc.
constructor initialises tax allocations through setTaxAlloc.
_getTaxes reads m_TotalAlloc to size the tax.
_getTaxes reads and stores m_EthReflectAlloc from the reflection service.
_getTaxes divides by pMax when computing allocations.
_updateBalances adds/subtracts entries of m_Balances.
payTaxes reads m_TaxAlloc entries and multiplies/divides them.
payTaxes reads m_TaxAddresses entries as payout destinations.
setTaxAlloc pushes and rewrites m_TaxAlloc entries.
setTaxAlloc adds/subtracts from m_TotalAlloc with the 10500 cap.
setTaxAlloc checks the caller against m_WebThree when updating the dev address.
_disperseEth computes m_EthReflectAmount from the new ETH delta.
_disperseEth compares and updates m_LastEthBal.
transferOwnership writes m_Owner, transferring privileged control.
setWebThree writes the privileged m_WebThree address.
blacklist writes m_Blacklist.
addLiquidity assigns the created m_UniswapV2Pair.
addLiquidity sets the m_Liquidity one-time guard flag.
launch writes the m_Launched trading gate timestamp.
_transfer consults m_ExcludedAddresses when determining trader status.
_transfer consults m_Blacklist for sender, recipient and tx.origin.
_sender parameter flows into _transfer.
_recipient parameter flows into _transfer.
_amount parameter participates in tax and balance arithmetic in _transfer.
_eth parameter participates in payout arithmetic in payTaxes.
_d parameter is the divisor in payTaxes arithmetic.
_timer parameter flows into launch.
_address parameter flows into setTaxAlloc.
_alloc parameter participates in allocation arithmetic in setTaxAlloc.
_a parameter flows into blacklist.
_senderFrom parameter flows into transferFrom.
_taxes local is subtracted from the amount in _updateBalances.
_idx local selects the array slot in setTaxAlloc.
_priorAlloc local participates in total allocation arithmetic in setTaxAlloc.

normalization_plan.reason: _sender is the sender parameter consumed directly by _transfer.
_recipient is the recipient parameter consumed directly by _transfer.
_amount is the transfer amount parameter used in _transfer arithmetic.
_eth is the ETH amount parameter used in payTaxes arithmetic.
_d is the denominator parameter used in payTaxes arithmetic.
_timer is the delay parameter consumed by launch.
_address is the address parameter consumed by setTaxAlloc.
_alloc is the allocation parameter consumed by setTaxAlloc.
_a is the address parameter consumed by blacklist.
_senderFrom is the sender parameter consumed by transferFrom.
_taxes local is applied within _updateBalances balance arithmetic.
_idx local is resolved within setTaxAlloc array indexing.
_priorAlloc local is consumed within setTaxAlloc arithmetic.
